definitions.explanation: Relating to matter, physics, or the physical world as opposed to mental, spiritual, or abstract concepts.

examples.japanese: {物理的|ぶつりてき}に{不可能|ふかのう}だ。
{物理的|ぶつりてき}な{距離|きょり}があるから{会|あ}えない。
examples.english: We can't meet because of the physical distance.

examples.japanese: {精神的|せいしんてき}にも{物理的|ぶつりてき}にも{疲|つか}れた。
examples.english: I'm tired both mentally and physically.

notes:
USAGE: {物理的|ぶつりてき} is a ～{的|てき} adjective often contrasted with {精神的|せいしんてき} (mental/spiritual).

FORMS:
・{物理的|ぶつりてき}な＋noun (physical ~)
・{物理的|ぶつりてき}に (physically - adverbial form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{物理的|ぶつりてき}に{不可能|ふかのう} (physically impossible)
・{物理的|ぶつりてき}な{距離|きょり} (physical distance)
・{物理的|ぶつりてき}な{制約|せいやく} (physical constraints)
・{物理的|ぶつりてき}な{存在|そんざい} (physical existence)

CONTRASTS:
・{精神的|せいしんてき} - mental, spiritual
・{肉体的|にくたいてき} - bodily, physical (relating to the body)

NOTE: {物理的|ぶつりてき} focuses on physical laws and material reality, while {肉体的|にくたいてき} focuses specifically on the human body.
